title: Magic Kingdom
description: Magic Kingdom opened in 1971 as the first park of Walt Disney World, and it remains the resort's castle park: six lands around a castle hub, from a turn-of-the-century main street to a jungle, a frontier, a fairy-tale village, and a tomorrowland. Its ride roster spans a mountain coaster, a mine train, a pirate boat ride, and a haunted house, and its past includes a wild toad ride, a submarine lagoon, and a skyway that once crossed the park. The park rewards slow walking: shop windows, street shows, and island caves carry as much theme as the rides.

demo.code:
RIDES = [
    ('Space Mountain', 'indoor steel coaster', 50),
    ('Big Thunder Mountain Railroad', 'mine train coaster', 40),
    ('Pirates of the Caribbean', 'boat dark ride', 30),
    ('Haunted Mansion', 'dark ride', 35),
    ('Seven Dwarfs Mine Train', 'family coaster', 55),
    ('TRON Lightcycle / Run', 'launched motorbike coaster', 60),
]
print('Wait-time estimate for Magic Kingdom')
total = 0
longest = None
for name, kind, wait in RIDES:
    total += wait
    print("%s (%s): %d min" % (name, kind, wait))
    if longest is None or wait > longest[2]:
        longest = (name, kind, wait)
print("Rides listed: %d" % len(RIDES))
print("Average wait: %.1f min" % (total / len(RIDES)))
print("Longest wait: %s at %d min" % (longest[0], longest[2]))
print("Tip: ride the longest-wait attraction first, then the rest in order.")
demo.expected_output:

title: EPCOT
description: EPCOT opened in 1982 as a park of two halves: a future world of technology and nature pavilions, and a world showcase of eleven country pavilions around a lagoon, entered beneath a geodesic sphere. Its ride roster spans a slow journey through communication history, a high-speed car test, a flying simulator, and a launched indoor coaster, and its past is a roster of beloved pavilions, Horizons, World of Motion, and a Norway boat ride, each replaced as the park remade itself. The park's evenings belong to the lagoon, and its days belong to walking the world.

demo.code:
LANDS = [
    ('World Celebration', 40),

    ('World Nature', 60),
    ('World Showcase (eleven country pavilions)', 70),
]
print('Itinerary plan for EPCOT')

print("Areas: %d" % len(LANDS))
print("Total area time: %d min (%.1f hours)" % (total, total / 60.0))
print("Plan order: visit areas in the order listed, slowest first on busy days.")

title: Disney's Hollywood Studios
description: Disney's Hollywood Studios opened in 1989 as a studio park with a working backlot tour, and it remade itself into a park of movie worlds: a toy backyard, a galaxy outpost, and a Hollywood boulevard of thrill rides. Its headline rides span a haunted hotel drop tower, a rock-and-roll launched coaster, and a trackless rise-of-the-resistance journey, and its past includes a great movie ride through film history and a backlot tour that once anchored the park. The studio frame survives in the boulevard and the facades.

demo.code:
RIDES = [
    ('The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror', 'drop tower dark ride'),
    ("Rock 'n' Roller Coaster", 'launched indoor coaster'),
    ('Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance', 'trackless dark ride'),
    ('Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run', 'interactive simulator'),
    ('Slinky Dog Dash', 'family launched coaster'),
    ("Mickey & Minnie's Runaway Railway", 'trackless dark ride'),
]
print("Ride-type classifier for Disney's Hollywood Studios")
counts = {}
for name, kind in RIDES:
    counts[kind] = counts.get(kind, 0) + 1
    print("%s -> %s" % (name, kind))
for kind in sorted(counts):
    print("%s: %d" % (kind, counts[kind]))
print("Total operating rides listed: %d" % len(RIDES))

Its headline rides span a banshee flight simulator, a yeti mountain coaster, and a safari through a savanna, and its past includes a spinning dinosaur coaster and bird shows that came and went.
